source_records.retained_domain: Smooth integral projective varieties over k as above; surface intersection and Riemann-Roch uses only dimension 2
statements: N^1(X)_R is finite dimensional. The ample numerical cone is open, numerical ampleness applies to each actual rational representative, the nef cone is closed, and nef plus ample is ample.
Every sufficiently divisible ample power is globally generated. For fixed coherent F and an actual ample integral A, H^i(X,F tensor A^m)=0 for i>0 and large m.
For a smooth projective surface and integral M, chi(M)=chi(O_X)+(M dot (M-K_X))/2, and h^2(M)=h^0(K_X-M).
Distinct prime curves on a smooth surface have nonnegative intersection, and C dot H>0 for nonzero effective prime C and ample H.
A bounded rational polytope has rational maximizing vertices for a rational linear objective; symmetric real matrices have Rayleigh-quotient maximizing eigenvectors.
On a smooth variety the normal local ring is the intersection of its height-one valuation rings; the associated graded of a regular-sequence ideal of a smooth center is Sym(I/I^2).
The multiplier ideal for a log resolution pi with I O=O(-F) is pi_* O(K_relative-floor(tF)). Only a displayed smooth-center blowup is used; no general resolution/vanishing input is needed here.
source_records.limitation: These ordinary foundational algebraic theorems are explicitly retained background; their independent complete foundational proofs were not newly reproduced or freshly downloaded. They supply no analytic nonample theorem.
